_comment: The image-forge remote backend's model inventory. install_forge.ps1 downloads
the 'hf' rows from Hugging Face; the 'copy' rows come from halo.local over SFTP
(paths under 'from' are on the Halo box) - they are already paid for, no re-download.
Dest folders are relative to the ComfyUI root (C:\forge\ComfyUI by default);
a 'dest' field downloads the file from the repo path in 'file' and moves it to 'dest'.
Qwen-Image-2.1 REPOS ARE PUBLIC (Comfy-Org mirrors): all rows download anonymously - verified
2026-11-07 (19 GB pulled with no token; 'unauthenticated requests' warning is rate-limit only).
Only qwen-research ORIGINAL repos (Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1) need sign-in + license accept.
Sizes verified against the repos 2026-10-28; PE + BiRefNet sizes verified 2026-11-07.

hf.why: Qwen-Image-2.1 unified gen+edit+native-RGBA, int8 (Unsloth: int8 > fp8 by LPIPS; Turing has int8 tensor cores)
2.1's dedicated VAE (16x spatial: legal sizes are 32-multiples)

hf_optional_gguf.why: RAM tier for the 11 GiB card (needs ComfyUI-GGUF, installed); repo-root file, lands in models/gguf/ where the loader looks

hf_extra.why: local background removal / cutout (RemoveBackground node, public repo). Feeds workflows/birefnet_cutout.json. Lands in models/background_removal/ where LoadBackgroundRemovalModel looks.
official Qwen-Image-2.1 prompt enhancer (t2i). Drives the 'refine on' rewrite in qwen21_t2i_pe.json AND the local LLM->SVG writer (TextGenerate). Public Comfy-Org repo, no token.
official Qwen-Image-2.1 prompt enhancer (image/edit). For the 'refine on' edit rewrite. Public repo, no token.

decode VAE fix by the int8-convrot author; A/B 2026-11-09 sharpness +50 pct (2890 vs 1931), same seed/content. Now the decode VAE in ALL qwen21 contracts. bf16 = hardware-portable (shareable with halo). Lands in models/vae/.
official 5-step distill LoRA; validated on-box (10 s warm, sharpness 2905). Feeds workflows/qwen21_t2i_pq5.json. Lands in models/loras/.
official 8-step distill LoRA (on disk, untested; 8-step sigmas noted in pq5 contract meta). models/loras/.

turbo-as-LoRA (avg rank 178): ANSWERS portal research Q4.1 - base int8 + this lora + official 8-step turbo sigmas RENDERS VALID (sharpness 1444, softer than turbo-int8 weights which stay the mid lane). On disk for base+turbo experiments. models/loras/.

Lightning-v2-RL 4-step distill (from portal research). VALIDATED 2026-11-09: 4 steps = 7 s warm, sharpness 3343 = best of the A/B set -> workflows/qwen21_t2i_lightning4.json is the FASTEST draft lane. Public repo. models/loras/.

pip_extra_why: local SVG/vector lane (tools/svg_tools.py): vtracer raster->SVG, svglib+reportlab+rlPyCairo SVG->PNG verify (Edge headless is the primary rasterizer, no pip needed).

copy_from_halo.why: zero-download bring-up pipeline (works before any HF download)
